title: Make Your Worship Portable
verse: You are to make a hanging for the entrance of the tent of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer. You are to make for the hanging five posts of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and their hooks will be gold, and you are to cast five bronze bases for them.
observation: In today’s chapter, we see Moses receiving instructions on how to create a “house of worship” that could go with them throughout their wandering in the wilderness. No matter where they went, the LORD was going to go with them. They were never to go anywhere without the LORD and they were not to create a space so “set in stone” that they could not carry it to the next place. This is a great reminder to us about settling in our hearts that we will carry the presence of the LORD with us wherever we go. Too many times we associate worship with our local church. When we think of worshiping God, we think it is only right to worship there. We also have a special place where we do our devotions at home and only think we can do devotions there. The problem is that we will skip our times with God while on vacation or when our schedules are interrupted. We must be careful to realize we carry the LORD’s presence with us wherever we go. Therefore, we keep our relationship with God “portable” and always with us.
application: For a solid week, have your quiet time with God in a new place. Let it be a reminder that the location doesn’t matter; intentional fellowship is what we are after.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every area of life.
